2607.14431.title: Smarter and Cheaper at Once: Byte-Exact KV-Cache Grafting Turns a Frozen Small Model into a Verified-Knowledge Flywheel
2607.14431.paper_summary: We report a way to make a frozen small language model both more capable and dramatically cheaper at once, without changing any weights. Verified knowledge is deposited once as a byte-exact key-value (KV) state artifact and later restored, by graft, into a fresh inference context. The restore is bit-exact: under a pinned deterministic configuration, the grafted logits are byte-for-byte identical to a fresh computation (SHA-256 equality), with zero KL divergence and 100% argmax agreement over fifty samples. We show that own-position graft is the unique numerically exact operating point on a model with floating-point rotary encoding, and we verify byte-exactness on two model scales (12B, 31B) and two GPU targets, one through a pre-registered replay. On AIME 2025, a frozen Gemma-4-12B moves from 80.0% to 93.3% once a verified solution library is grafted, above its own 77.5% and its 31B sibling's 89.2% published anchors. On the recurring case, eight problems the base model never solves within a 401,026-token budget are answered from cached verified solutions in 61 total decode tokens, a factor of 6,574 fewer tokens and about 8,700x less energy; the capability claim proper rests on held-out transfer (7 of 7 at 31B). The same byte-exact store widens usable context from 32,768 to 2,854,766 tokens at zero extra accelerator memory, and moves byte-identical between machines of the same architecture. We describe the system at the behavior level; the engine is proprietary, and every reported number is backed by committed input and output hashes so the scoring can be re-checked without it.
2607.14431.paper_summary_zh: 我們報告了一種方法，可以使凍結的小型語言模型在不改變任何權重的情況下，同時變得更具能力和顯著更便宜。經過驗證的知識一次性存儲為字節精確的鍵值（KV）狀態工件，然後通過嫁接恢復到一個新的推理上下文中。恢復是位元精確的：在固定的確定性配置下，嫁接的logits與新的計算在字節上完全相同（SHA-256相等），KL散度為零，並且在五十個樣本上有100%的argmax一致性。我們展示了自位置嫁接是具有浮點旋轉編碼的模型上唯一的數值精確操作點，並且我們在兩個模型規模（12B，31B）和兩個GPU目標上驗證了字節精確性，其中一個是通過預註冊的重播。在AIME 2025上，凍結的Gemma-4-12B在嫁接經過驗證的解決方案庫後，從80.0%提升到93.3%，超過其自身的77.5%和其31B兄弟的89.2%已發表的基準。在重複的案例中，基礎模型在401,026個標記的預算內從未解決的八個問題，從緩存的經過驗證的解決方案中用61個總解碼標記回答，這比原來少了6,574個標記，並且約節省了8,700倍的能量；能力聲明的正當性基於保留的轉移（31B的7個中有7個）。相同的字節精確存儲將可用上下文從32,768擴展到2,854,766個標記，且不需要額外的加速器內存，並且在相同架構的機器之間字節上保持一致。我們在行為層面描述系統；引擎是專有的，並且每個報告的數字都有承諾的輸入和輸出哈希支持，因此可以在不需要它的情況下重新檢查得分。
